organizationId.description: ADR-040 — which organization to log into, if you belong to more than one. Defaults to your oldest active membership.

entityId.description: ADR-041 — which Entity (subsidiary) within the resolved organization to log into. Defaults to your oldest active EntityMembership there, or omitted entirely if you have none (plain organization-level access, unchanged).

totpCode.description: ADR-050 — required if the account has MFA enabled: either a 6-digit TOTP code from an authenticator app, or one single-use backup code (format XXXXX-XXXXX). Omitted/missing on an MFA-enabled account returns 401 MFA_REQUIRED rather than issuing tokens.
